omissions.description: Complete selected device-fabrication resource coverage under SO-DEVICE-FABRICATION. o_A/o_B retain SU-8/PDMS ratios, curing, thickness and inlet dimensions, but their source-described fabrication resource omits the 50 μm photomask input and final cut/peel/punch handling reported in p00034–35. Add these within the existing equipment description; no extra specimen Operation or intermediate State is needed. This is an available detail repair, not missing evidence or a blocker to the chip-to-tissue interface.

Complete SO-REAGENT-INVENTORY by adding the unambiguous Table S3 vendor/catalogue identities to the already assigned reagent resources (for example R0192 dNTP mix, Y9240L Enzymatics inhibitor, AM2694 SUPERase In, M0202L T4 ligase, A63880 AMPure, KK2601 KAPA, EO0491 Proteinase K, and the unambiguous buffer identifiers). The candidate retains most names/vendors and the Nextera catalogue but omits most available catalogue identifiers. Keep Table S3 Maxima EP7051 and the primary resource table EP0751 source-qualified rather than silently reconciling them; do not assign the ambiguous adjacent Dynabeads/B&W numbers by guess. This is a recoverable identity-documentation repair, with the known general assay interfaces intact.
